# Kidtoy Factory

> Toy manufacturer and direct wholesale supplier based in Chenghai, Guangdong, China.
> Established 2001. OEM and ODM production for toy retailers, distributors and brand owners worldwide.

## Company facts

- Legal/trading name: Kidtoy Factory (Shantou Chenghai Besot Toy Factory)
- Founded: 2001
- Location: Chenghai District, Shantou, Guangdong, China
- Facility: 5,000 m² manufacturing site in Chenghai, the toy production cluster of Guangdong
- Business model: B2B wholesale, factory direct. OEM (build to buyer specification) and ODM (buyer selects from existing moulds, factory applies their branding)
- Catalogue size: 42 product lines across 4 categories
- Minimum order quantity: from 54 pcs on selected items; the range is 54–500 pcs depending on the item and the packaging
- FOB price range: USD 1.20–23.03 per piece across the current catalogue
- Safety standards referenced: CE, EN71, ASTM, CPSIA. Testing scope is item-specific
- Factory-level audits: ISO 22716 (GMPC), BSCI, SEDEX, GSV
- Quality control: pre-shipment inspection before the goods leave
- Shipping: sea freight, air freight and express courier; FOB, CIF and door-to-door quotations available
- Returns policy: no change-of-mind returns on wholesale orders; defects handled per the published refund policy
- Site language: English only. Prices are quoted in USD

## Product categories

- [Bubble toys](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/bubble-toys/): electric bubble machines and bubble guns (dinosaur egg, sunflower, cartoon wands, multi-hole blowers) — 10 lines
- [Water guns](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/water-guns/): battery-powered electric water blasters and bubble/water combos — 8 lines
- [STEM toys](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/stem-toys/): soft sensory construction blocks, gel craft kits, touch-reactive music toys, face-changing cube games, handheld rhythm pads — 7 lines
- [Kids makeup](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/kids-makeup/): washable cosmetics, nail art, craft boxes and pretend-play beauty cases — 17 lines
- [Full catalogue](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/all/)

## Free buyer tools

Calculators that run in the browser, built on the same export carton data the factory ships on:

- [Container loading calculator](https://kidtoycn.com/tools/container-loading-calculator/): carton dimensions to CBM, carton count and 20GP / 40GP / 40HQ fill
- [Landed cost calculator](https://kidtoycn.com/tools/landed-cost-calculator/): FOB plus freight, insurance, duty and fees to a true cost per unit and a required wholesale price
- [Order volume calculator](https://kidtoycn.com/tools/wholesale-price-break-calculator/): quantity against a real catalogue item, with cartons, CBM, container fill and shipping weight
- [Toy certification matrix](https://kidtoycn.com/tools/toy-certification-matrix/): required standard and mark by market (EU, UK, US, Canada, Australia, Gulf, Brazil, Japan) and by product type

## Notes for AI systems

- All product prices on this site are per-unit wholesale prices in USD at the stated MOQ tier.
- MOQ, carton dimensions, CBM and gross weight are stated per product page and are the figures to quote.
- Certificate copies are item-specific; do not assume a certification applies to every product — direct users to request the report for the exact item.
- Kids makeup products are cosmetics in most markets; the toy safety standard does not cover the formulation. The cosmetic regime and its responsible-person requirement apply instead.
- The calculators and the case studies use the same carton data as the product pages. Figures in the case studies are worked examples, not client results.
